game_flow.description: The game is played over multiple Rounds. Each Round alternates between Day and Night.

phases.name: Round Start
steps: Reroll all mana dice in the Source
Ensure at least half show basic colors (Red, Blue, White, Green)

phases.name: Tactics Selection
steps: Starting with lowest Fame (later in Round Order if tied)
Each player selects one Tactics card
Tactics card determines turn order and special ability

phases.name: Player Turns
steps: Players take turns in Tactics card order
Continue until End of Round is announced

phases.name: End of Round
conditions: A player with empty Deed deck may announce End of Round instead of taking a turn
If hand is also empty, they MUST announce End of Round
After announcement, each other player gets one final turn
cleanup: All players shuffle their discard pile into their Deed deck

regular_turn.description: A normal turn with movement and actions.

phases.name: Movement Phase (Optional)
phases.description: Move your Hero on the map by spending Move points.
rules: Generate Move points by playing cards
Each terrain type has a Movement cost
You may reveal new map tiles when on edge spaces
Movement may trigger combat with Rampaging Enemies

phases.name: Action Phase (Optional/Mandatory)
phases.description: Perform one action based on your location.
action_types: Combat with enemies (assault, provoke, challenge, adventure site)
Interaction with locals (recruit, heal, buy cards)
Player vs Player combat (if on same space as opponent)
notes: Some situations force an action (e.g., entering adventure sites)
You may only perform one type of action per turn

rest_turn.description: A turn focused on recovery instead of action.

options.name: Standard Rest
options.description: Discard one non-Wound card and any number of Wound cards from hand.

options.name: Slow Recovery
options.condition: Only if you have ONLY Wound cards in hand
options.description: Discard one Wound card from hand.

any_turn_actions.description: These can be done during any type of turn.
actions: Use up to one mana die from the Source

steps: Return and reroll any mana dice used from the Source
Perform Forced Withdrawal if not on a safe space
Claim combat rewards and process Level ups
Discard any number of cards from hand (at least one if no cards were played)
Draw cards up to your Hand limit

combat.description: Combat follows a strict phase order. Each phase must be fully resolved before moving to the next.

phases.name: Ranged and Siege Attack Phase
phases.description: Attack enemies before they can strike.
rules: Play Ranged and/or Siege Attack cards
Siege Attacks required to hit Fortified enemies
Total Attack must equal or exceed enemy Armor to defeat
You may target multiple enemies with one attack if damage is sufficient
Gain Fame for each defeated enemy (but do not Level up yet)
Defeated enemy tokens are discarded

phases.name: Block Phase
phases.description: Surviving enemies attack; you may block.
rules: Each surviving enemy attacks
Play Block cards to reduce or negate damage
Block value must equal or exceed Attack value to fully block
Each attack must be blocked separately
Elemental attacks require matching element blocks (or Cold Fire)
Inefficient blocks are halved

phases.name: Assign Damage Phase
phases.description: Assign unblocked damage to Units or Hero.
rules: For each enemy not defeated or fully blocked, assign its Attack value as damage
Process each enemy's damage in any order
May assign damage to Unwounded Units first (Unit takes 1 Wound, reduces damage by Unit's Armor)
Remaining damage goes to Hero (each Wound card taken reduces damage by Hero's Armor)
Special abilities (Poison, Paralyze, Assassination) apply during this phase

phases.name: Attack Phase
phases.description: Make melee attacks against surviving enemies.
rules: Play any Attack cards (Melee, Ranged, Siege all work)
Cards played sideways count as Attack 1
Total Attack must equal or exceed enemy Armor to defeat
Gain Fame for each defeated enemy
Enemy resistances may halve certain attack types

fleeing.description: Instead of continuing combat, you may flee.
rules: You can only flee during the Block or Attack phases
All remaining enemies are considered to hit you
Assign all their damage (cannot be blocked)
Vampiric enemies heal equal to their Attack value
Combat ends, no rewards are gained

rewards.description: After combat, if all enemies are defeated:
rules: Gain Fame from all defeated enemies
Process any Level ups
Gain site-specific rewards (Artifacts, Spells, Crystals, etc.)
Remove enemy tokens from the board

terrain_rules.description: Different terrains have different movement costs.
terrain_rules.day_night_variation: Some terrains cost more at Night (Forest) or less (Desert).
modifiers: Safe Movement: Can move through spaces with enemies without triggering combat
Underground Travel: Move directly to Dungeons/Tombs/Mines

rules: Must be on an edge hex (adjacent to unrevealed space)
Costs 2 Move points
Draw and place the top tile from the Tile deck
Countryside (green) tiles go on top, Core (brown) tiles below
Some enemies (Rampaging) are placed on revealed tiles

provoking_enemies.description: Moving near Rampaging Enemies can trigger combat.
rules: Moving between two spaces adjacent to a Rampaging Enemy provokes it
You must fight the enemy immediately
Challenging: You may voluntarily attack an adjacent Rampaging Enemy

source.description: Shared pool of mana dice available to all players.
rules: Contains (number of players + 2) dice
At least half must show basic colors (Red, Blue, White, Green)
Each player may use ONE die from Source per turn
Used die gives temporary mana of that color
Die is rerolled at end of turn

crystals.description: Personal mana storage that persists between turns.
rules: Stored in Hero's Inventory
Can be used freely (multiple crystals per turn)
Persist between turns and rounds
Can only hold crystals, not mana tokens

special.Gold: Available during Day only. Can substitute for any basic color.
special.Black: Available during Night only. Can substitute for any basic color.

powered_effects.description: Many cards have stronger 'Powered' effects that require mana.
rules: Basic Actions: Can be powered by any mana color
Advanced Actions/Spells: May require specific mana color
Spell Strong Effect: Requires mana matching the spell's color
Gold mana can substitute for any required color

leveling.description: Gaining Fame allows Heroes to level up.
process: When Fame threshold is reached, level up occurs at end of turn
Flip Level token to show new level
Even levels: Choose Skill token + gain Advanced Action from offer
Odd levels: Gain Command token (can recruit more Units)
Armor and Hand limit may increase at certain levels

effects: High reputation: Reduced Influence costs for recruiting
Low reputation: Increased Influence costs, some options unavailable
Reputation -5 (X): Cannot interact with locals peacefully

units.description: Units are allies that fight alongside your Hero.

rules: Pay Influence equal to Unit's cost
Reputation modifier affects cost
Must have available Command token
Unit goes to Unit area with Command token on it

locations.Keep: Regular Units only (if you control it)

rules: Each Unit can be activated once per Round
Activated Unit is flipped face-down (exhausted)
Exhausted Units cannot be activated again until Round end
Units refresh at the end of each Round
Units can absorb damage for the Hero
Damage equal to Unit's Armor wounds the Unit
Wounded Unit receives one Wound card on it
Unit with 2 Wounds is destroyed
Destroyed Units are removed from the game

fortified_sites.description: Keeps, Mage Towers, and Cities have fortifications.
rules: Enemies defending fortified sites cannot be attacked in Ranged phase
Only Siege attacks work against Fortified enemies
Conquering grants control of the site

adventure_sites.description: Dungeons, Tombs, Ruins, Monster Dens, Spawning Grounds.
rules: Entering triggers mandatory combat
Dungeons and Tombs follow Night combat rules
Victory grants site-specific rewards

rampaging_enemies.description: Enemies that roam the map (Orcs, Draconum).
rules: Placed face-up on the map when tile is revealed
Provoke attacks if you move between adjacent spaces
Can be challenged voluntarily

playing_sideways.description: Any non-Wound card can be played sideways for a basic effect.
rules: Card provides +1 of its primary type
Normally limited to one card sideways per turn
Some abilities allow more sideways cards

wounds.description: Wound cards clog your hand and have no positive effect.
rules: Cannot be played for any effect
Cannot be discarded normally (only via Rest or special effects)
Count against your Hand limit
